Legendary filmmaker Singeetham Srinivasa Rao dies at 94

Legendary filmmaker and writer Singeetham Srinivasa Rao died in Chennai on Saturday night at the age of 94 due to age-related health complications. He began his career at 41 with the Telugu movie 'Neeti Nijayati' in 1972.
